Mme Laurene Boucard	Valentin Peron
academic guidance, mentorship
Mme Laurene Boucard served as Valentin Peron's academic tutor during his internship at Epitech Rennes.

Mr Julien Perron	Valentin Peron
professional supervision, mentorship
Mr Julien Perron acted as Valentin Peron's company tutor, overseeing his internship project at Ouest-France.

Ouest-France	Valentin Peron
internship, project development
Valentin Peron completed an internship at Ouest-France, developing a Machine Learning Pipeline for article extraction.

Ouest-France	The SIPA Ouest-France group
corporate structure, media operations
Ouest-France is a part of the SIPA Ouest-France group, which has diversified operations including print media and digital platforms.

Novo 19	Ouest-France
media expansion, broadcasting
Novo 19 is a television channel launched as part of the SIPA Ouest-France group's expansion into multimedia content.

Fabrice Bazard	Ouest-France
leadership, management
Fabrice Bazard is the General Director at Ouest-France, indicating his leadership role in the organization.

Christophe Duprat	Ouest-France
leadership, management
Christophe Duprat is responsible for the information systems at Ouest-France, indicating a key managerial role.

AI Charter	Ouest-France
ethics, data sovereignty
Ouest-France has established an AI Charter to ensure responsible use of AI, reflecting its commitment to ethics and data sovereignty.

Data Science pole	SIRAI team
AI development, research
The Data Science pole operates within the SIRAI team, focusing on AI research and development at Ouest-France.

Data Science pole	Products and Services pole
deployment, integration
The Products and Services pole manages the deployment of AI models developed by the Data Science pole.

Ouest-France	Ouest-Éclair
historical connection
Ouest-Éclair was the former name of Ouest-France, indicating a historical connection between the two.

Internship	SIRAI team
work experience, AI development
The internship involved integration into the SIRAI team, specifically in the Data Science pole, to work on AI-based solutions.

Ouest-Éclair	World War II
historical transition, rebranding
Ouest-Éclair changed its name to Ouest-France after being liberated during World War II, indicating a historical transition.

Newspaper indexing pipeline	RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation)
data extraction, historical research
The pipeline supports RAG by extracting articles from historical newspapers for use in a chatbot to answer historical questions.

Indexing Pipeline	Ouest-France
compliance, internal policy
The Indexing Pipeline is developed to comply with Ouest-France's internal AI vision and data sovereignty requirements.

Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct	Vision Language Models (VLMs)
implementation, advanced OCR
Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct is a specific implementation that exemplifies the capabilities of Vision Language Models in OCR tasks.

Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct	vLLM
deployment, performance enhancement
vLLM is used for deploying the Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct model efficiently, improving OCR performance.

Indexing Pipeline	Tesseract
technology evaluation, performance limitations
Tesseract, as a traditional OCR tool, was initially explored but found ineffective for the high-resolution and complex layouts tackled by the indexing pipeline.

EasyOCR	Indexing Pipeline
technology evaluation, inadequate performance
EasyOCR was assessed in the development of the indexing pipeline but failed to meet the requirements due to layout and formatting challenges.

VLM based OCR	layout detection
system design, technological improvement
The use of VLM based OCR revealed the limitation of processing entire pages, highlighting the need for layout detection to handle memory constraints efficiently.

DocLayNet	YOLO11-Document-Layout-Analysis
data adaptation, document recognition
YOLO11-Document-Layout-Analysis model uses DocLayNet to detect and analyze various document structures, improving layout detection for newspaper pages.

YOLO11-Document-Layout-Analysis	internship presentation
innovation inspiration, process enhancement
The internship presentation highlighted a potential approach of combining machine learning with rule-based post-processing, leading to improvements in YOLO11-Document-Layout-Analysis's performance.

historical document analysis	layout detection
document processing, historical challenges
Layout detection is a crucial component in processing historical documents, addressing challenges in multicolumn and degraded newspaper layouts.

PP-DocLayout-L	YOLO-based model
model integration, improved accuracy
The PP-DocLayout-L and YOLO-based model are combined in a hybrid system to improve document layout detection by leveraging the strengths of each model.

PP-DocLayout-L	PaddleOCR
development, technological advancement
PaddleOCR developed the PP-DocLayout-L model, indicating its direct involvement in advancing document layout detection technology.

Ensemble Approach	PP-DocLayout-L
model reliability, ensemble strategy
The Ensemble Approach uses the PP-DocLayout-L model as the primary source for layout detection due to its high confidence predictions.

Ensemble Approach	YOLO-based model
gap filling, ensemble strategy
The Ensemble Approach integrates the YOLO-based model to fill gaps and improve detection of smaller or irregular blocks.

Article Segmentation	Large Language Models (LLMs)
text grouping, segmentation strategy
LLMs are explored in the context of Article Segmentation to group related text blocks based on content and spatial information.

Internship	Ouest-France
professional experience, machine learning
The internship was conducted at Ouest-France, providing a unique opportunity to develop a machine learning pipeline.

Qwen 2.5 VL (7B)	Vision-Language Model (VLM)
model application, performance enhancement
Qwen 2.5 VL (7B) is a specific type of Vision-Language Model that was used to improve performance in article extraction.

EasyOCR	Tesseract
limitations, technological challenge
Both Tesseract and EasyOCR struggled with the complex layouts of historical newspapers, leading to exploration of more advanced methods.

PP-DocLayout-L	YOLO11
ensemble approach, layout detection
YOLO11 and PP-DocLayout-L were used together in an ensemble approach to improve layout detection.
